summary: BI Developer with nearly two years of freelance experience building Power BI dashboards and decision-ready reporting. My work spans sales and retail, churn, supply chain, e-commerce, customer satisfaction, marketing, HR, and healthcare, with a focus on data preparation, validation, SQL and Power Query, dimensional modeling, and KPI design. I also build analytics projects, explore Python-based model evaluation, streamline reporting with Excel and VBA, and share practical learning through The Data Tea.

Applied clear definitions and privacy-aware practices to support consistent, reliable labeled data.
Practiced human–AI collaboration concepts relevant to AI operations, trust and safety, and machine-learning data support.
Queried an approximately 79-million-row search-performance warehouse with DuckDB and SQL, aggregating Parquet data for analysis.
Developed Python-based feature-preparation workflows and machine-learning experiments using anonymized search-performance data.
Explored temporal and client-grouped validation approaches to assess model generalization and identify potential data-leakage risks.
Completed a capstone project that was independently reviewed and approved.
Deliver confidential BI engagements, translating business questions into Power BI reports, KPI definitions, semantic models, and DAX measures.
Shape source data with Power Query and SQL, and document metric definitions, transformation logic, and reporting handover.
Coached aspiring freelancers on professional positioning, portfolio and CV development, freelance-platform profiles, proposal writing, and client communication.
Reviewed learner portfolios, CVs, and freelance profiles, providing practical feedback and structured weekly development challenges.
Analyzed freelance project listings to identify recurring skill requirements and help learners position practical services.
Mentored learners in Excel formulas and functions, data cleaning, PivotTables, charts, dashboards, Power Query, Power Pivot, and DAX.
Taught data transformation with Power Query and data modeling with Power Pivot, including DAX calculations in Excel’s Data Model.
Designed practical exercises and reviewed learner work to strengthen analytical reporting and dashboard skills.

about_paragraphs: I’m a BI Developer with nearly two years of freelance experience turning business questions and scattered data into clear, reliable Power BI dashboards. I work across the reporting process—from data preparation and validation with Excel, SQL, and Power Query to dimensional modeling, DAX measures, KPI definitions, interactive reports, and practical handover documentation.

My work has touched sales and retail, churn, supply chain, e-commerce, customer satisfaction, marketing, HR, and healthcare. Beyond BI, I’ve worked with Python, SQL, and DuckDB on search-performance data during an ML internship; mentored learners in Excel and analytics; and coached aspiring freelancers. Through independent analytics projects and Excel/VBA automation, I keep finding ways to make reporting more efficient and useful.
